title: Russian Drone Strike Kills Two in Kyiv Residential Building Despite Trump Energy Ceasefire
detail: A Russian drone strike hit a residential apartment building in Kyiv, killing two people. The attack occurred despite the so-called 'energy ceasefire' announced by former US President Trump, highlighting the continued Russian targeting of Ukrainian civilians and infrastructure.

title: Poland Arrests Two Turkish Nationals for Russia-Linked Arson at Starlink Ground Station
detail: Polish authorities arrested two Turkish nationals suspected of setting fire to a Starlink satellite ground station in what officials described as a Russia-linked sabotage operation. The incident is the latest in an alleged Russian covert sabotage campaign targeting NATO infrastructure, raising concerns about hybrid warfare operations against alliance communications.

media.caption: Polish authorities arrested two Turkish nationals over a fire at a Starlink ground station in an alleged Russia-linked sabotage operation
